formula.category_score: S_c = sum_{j in V_c} w_j x_j / sum_{j in V_c} w_j * 100
formula.index: Index = sum_c W_c S_c / sum_c W_c, over categories with at least one verified checkpoint
formula.x_j: 1 or 0; ? items are excluded from numerator and denominator

rules.unverified: ? excluded from both numerator and denominator; shown as ? in the UI
rules.verified_absence: 0 only when the official page has been reviewed sufficiently to establish that the feature or disclosure is absent; a failed search or unreadable page is ?
rules.no_inferred_values: No value may be filled in by estimation or by generic assumption about a site type.
rules.probability: Draw probabilities are never inferred; F4 records only whether a probability or method is published.
rules.javascript_rendered_pages: If the body text cannot be read, the affected items are ?.

eligibility.reason: Sites with too few verified checkpoints cannot be ranked reliably.

rounding: Scores are shown to one decimal place. Prime weights make exact round results unlikely; any exact 0 or 100 is reported as the result of uniform verified values, not adjusted.
